Container.Name: sharedrive-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 16 database for Sharedrive. Deploy this container before starting the main sharedrive container. The database credentials here must match those set in your sharedrive .env file.
Container.Requires: Docker network "privatedrive-net" must exist. Create with: docker network create privatedrive-net

Config.Name: Database Name
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name. Must match POSTGRES_DB in your sharedrive .env file.

Config.Name: Database User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user. Must match POSTGRES_USER in your sharedrive .env file.

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password. Must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD in your sharedrive .env file. Use a strong, unique password.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Path on the host where PostgreSQL data files are stored. This directory must persist across container restarts.
